{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
num_test_orders = len(test_orders)
print(f'Number of internal test orders: {num_test_orders}')

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_no_test = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_no_test['revenue'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}')

# Return the value for submission
total_revenue"}
